properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: go.mod dependency view of the same filippo.io/edwards25519 v1.0.0-rc.1 declaration as LIB-75349ed3. The crate provides edwards25519/Curve25519 group arithmetic (not the signature scheme itself — Ed25519 signatures come from stdlib crypto/ed25519); used at common/public_key.go:95 for public-key point validation. Note v1.0.0-rc.1 is a release candidate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Rust hmac@0.8.1 crate pinned in the lockfile of the docs example on-chain program (docs/_examples/program/101/accounts/program). Transitive dependency of the Solana/Anchor toolchain (pulled by tiny-bip39). The example program's own Rust source contains no crypto calls; this is the dependency inventory for what the docs build ships. Same crate is also pinned in the data and hello example lockfiles.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@0.4.0 crate in the docs example program's lockfile, pulled by tiny-bip39 (BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed KDF). Dependency-inventory entry; also pinned in the data and hello example lockfiles.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: blake3@1.3.3 crate in the docs example program's lockfile; used by the Solana toolchain for hashing. BLAKE3 is a modern hash — only Grover's square-root speedup applies, not an urgent migration. Dependency-inventory entry; also pinned in the data and hello lockfiles.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The nonce .md docs under docs/src/advanced describe the durable-nonce mechanism (a Solana replay-protection nonce — an on-chain account value, not a cryptographic nonce/IV); the example programs create and query nonce accounts. Shard-1 object; recorded for cross-reference only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: filippo.io/edwards25519 v1.0.0-rc.1 — the SDK's only direct crypto dependency; implements the edwards25519 group used to validate Solana public keys as curve points (common/public_key.go:95). Available in the shipped library whether or not the application calls it beyond that site; v1.0.0-rc.1 is a release candidate. The algorithm view of the same go.mod line is ALG-683d5cd2.
